releaseNotes: Requires DBX 0.6.59+. Adds Chinese/English UI following DBX, clearer JSON hierarchy and counted folds, independent view preferences, per-container query input recovery and a simpler workbench. Query input (including SQL literals and parameters) is now saved locally as plaintext in private files; restoration never executes queries. MCP remains read-only; UI writes retain confirmation and ETag safeguards. macOS ARM64 only.
